tagline: Twin-pane KDE file manager with a native dark theme on a fast Selkies web desktop, with Kate, krename and RAR built in.
description: Krusader file manager with native Dark Mode, running on a hardware-accelerated Selkies web desktop. It responds much faster than the noVNC-based Krusader containers (binhex / jlesage / ich777).
author: Junker der Provinz
title: Krusader
